test_title: PYST 3: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

I __had to got up__ early, so I have been in a daze all morning.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'had to get up'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The improved sentence is:** 'had to get up'**
 
• The phrase** "I had to got up"** is **incorrect **because "got" is not the correct form to use after "had to."
 
• The **correct form** is the base form of the verb, which in this case is "get." So, **"I had to get up"** is the correct phrase.
 
• The phrase **"had to"** is used to talk about obligation in the past.

Therefore, the **corrected sentence** is: *"I had to get up early, so I have been in a daze all morning."*
